items.docs:
Get all layers for a specific project.

Args:
    project_id: The ID of the project to get layers for (validated for read access)
    layer_service: Service for handling layer operations
Upload a CSV or GeoJSON file as a generic sandbox layer.

Update a layer with the provided data.

Args:
    request: Layer update request containing layer ID and fields to update
    layer_service: Service for handling layer operations
    enrichment_service: Service for handling enrichment operations

Returns:
    Response containing success message and updated layer

Raises:
    HTTPException: If layer not found or no fields provided for update

Soft delete a layer.

Args:
    request: Layer delete request containing layer ID and project ID
    layer_service: Service for handling layer operations

Returns:
    Response containing success message

Raises:
    HTTPException: If layer not found
